column1: # Every row records the gate, the exact command, the make exit status and
# the gate's own verdict line. The rows are the SUMMARY of the run: the
# raw transcripts are build outputs, not evidence artifacts, and they carry
# the trailing whitespace that the diff-check gate rejects.
# The commands were run SERIALLY. The compiler writes its intermediary
# assembly to the FIXED path /tmp/holyc-asm.s, so two compiler invocations
# that overlap destroy each other's scratch file.
